text: the total TUT for the training session was approximately equal because of the greater number of sets performed for the powerlifting-style condition. These findings are in contrast to a follow-up study showing that when the total number of sets were equated, a bodybuilding-style workout (10RM) elicited greater hypertrophic adaptations compared to a powerlifting-style workout (3RM) (213). Here, the TUT was markedly greater both during each set as well as over the course of the training session.
